title: Culture-Aware Machine Translation in Large Language Models: Benchmarking and Investigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the translation quality of culture-specific items (CSIs) across 12 language directions using a multi-dimensional assessment framework that scores contextual accuracy, cultural adaptation, functional equivalence, fidelity, and naturalness to assess how well models bridge cultural gaps and avoid cultural conflict.

Measuring the cosine similarity between default (unconstrained) translations and translations generated under explicit semantic or communicative constraints to detect the models' systemic default preference toward semantic-oriented translation approaches.
